displayPattern: 7-segment display on a Trane S9V2 two-stage variable-speed furnace (Service Facts S9V2-SF-2A-EN): E14
meaning: Personality module missing: the control cannot read the information stored on the board.
causes: Personality module not installed or not fully seated
diySteps: Do not pull the control board to look for the module with power on
Technician: disconnect power, then install or fully seat the personality module. The chart lists a module that was not programmed, and a faulty IFC, as possible causes
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. E14 is a missing personality module. E15 is the module and the control both corrupted.
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
